title: 군사학교 각종 증명수수료 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00507:20000110:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Rules on Selection of Students and Collection of Tuition Fees at the Korea National Defense University) <Rule No. 507, Jan. 10, 2000>

(1) (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

(2) Omitted.

(3) (Amendment of Another Statute) The Rules on Fees for Various Certificates Issued by Military Schools are partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 1 of Article 2 is replaced with the following:

1. The Korea National Defense University under the Korea National Defense University Establishment Act.
